Hi Aisha — thanks for sending the W-9. I’ve looped in Marissa from Procurements to action the PO.

Quick note from our onboarding checks: our vendor intake flagged a mismatch between the name provided on the W-9 (Spectra Labs) and the legal name format we have on file / IRS lookup (Spectra Laboratories, Inc.). That can delay PO activation. To move forward we need one of the following pieces of evidence:

- A letter from the IRS confirming the EIN (Official IRS EIN verification letter or 147C), OR
- A corrected W-9 showing the legal name exactly as it appears with the IRS and the same EIN, OR
- A state filing/certificate showing Spectra Laboratories, Inc. is the legal entity for the EIN provided.

If you can attach one of those, we can fast-track the review. For expediency, a photo/scan of the IRS letter + a signed W-9 with the legal name would be ideal. Once Marissa confirms the docs, we can clear the PO hold and proceed to issue.

I’m cc’ing Monica from Finance as she’ll need to finalize payment terms once the PO is active.

Thanks —

Hi Aisha — thanks for the prompt follow-up and for sending the IRS verification letter and updated W-9. I reviewed the attachments; the IRS image and the corrected W-9 meet our verification criteria.

Next steps:
- Please confirm you want the PO nominal value set to $120,000 (annual contracted spend) and billing address to be the legal address shown on the W-9. If that’s correct, I’ll create a conditional PO and route it for approvals.
- We require the updated W-9 uploaded via the DocuSign link so the signatory signature is time-stamped in our records: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/EXAMPLE-SPECTRA-W9 (link expires in 7 days).
- Once DocuSign is completed and we confirm matching legal name + EIN, Procurement will clear the PO gate and issue the PO number (expected within 2 business days after verification).

For transparency: the PO will remain on hold until the DocuSign-signed W-9 is returned. The IRS verification image you provided is acceptable as interim evidence and prevents further delays while you complete the DocuSign step.

If you prefer to send a 147C instead of DocuSign, note that will delay us by the time to receive the 147C from the IRS, but we will accept it.

Thanks — will wait for your confirmation on the PO amount and DocuSign completion.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
